segments.en: Tell me, does something happen?
Hello.
Hello.
How are you?
I am fine.
Where are you from?
Gujarat.
Gujarat.
And tell me, what do you do?
Why do I feel like...
Why do I feel like you are sitting in class and talking to me?
I am sitting on the bed.
Oh, do you have a job?
Business.
Businessman, wow.
Actually, I only like businessmen. People who do jobs get a salary, but businessmen... if the business settles, then I am rich, then I will buy it.
I am a girl, right? I have my own thoughts that I want to become a very big businesswoman. Money and money.
Because right now, I feel like everything is just stopping.
I don't know, what is your side?
I am telling you my side. Whoever has this, they have people roaming around them.
Look at Narendra Modi, making tea, the poor guy reached there.
Now a reel comes that sugar is expensive because Narendra Modi also reached that post while making tea, so I laugh seeing this.
Yes, tell me.
So, since when have you been on this app?
One week.
Since when?
One week ago, one week.

Oh, one week. Actually, it happens that on this app, I mostly find people whose hearts are broken, who are alone. They overthink and come to this app. And I myself, I am also like that. My heart is broken. What about you?
Your heart must have been broken, that's why you came.
Nothing happened, I just came to have fun.
No, no. No person comes like this without a reason.
An advertisement came in between.
Yes, on Instagram.
On Instagram, right?

I also, you know, came here from Instagram. I thought I would get it earlier. I was going into so much depression, this, that, overthinking. Instead of that, I would have got this app. I would have talked to everyone, chilled.
So, chill, chill. In life, one should chill.
I did so much blabbering. Anyway, what is your business?
Hardware items, wholesale.
What kind?
Hardware items, wholesale.
Oh, oh, oh, oh. Then it's fine, man.
I am doing nursing. I just give injections directly, injections.
Take an injection. I think if someone has a headache, I don't give them stomach ache injections or medicines. I have so much trust in nursing.
I am of no use.
